review_method.context: The independent reviewer read original source before author conclusions and then reviewed every scoped fixture. The same reviewer retained its source-plan context for fixture review; this is not represented as a fresh context for every pass.
review_method.source_reading: All scoped paragraphs, rules, constraints and notes and the needed canonical premises were read from the pin, including visual inspection of the Japanese note omitted by text extraction. Compiler outcomes did not establish source legality.
review_method.corrections: Authors made bounded owned-path corrections; the coordinator inspected the exact deltas, exercised regressions and collected fresh main-checkout evidence. No source or fixture approval was delegated to the authors.
review_method.status_text_cleanup: The coordinator removed 28 authoring-time unreviewed prefixes from character oracle descriptions without changing their semantics. Current adjudications remain separately recorded, and all affected observations were refreshed rather than relabelled.
review_method.permanent_regressions: Two author-only assertions that catalogue state must always be draft were removed from the permanent facet-coverage tests. Exact coverage/pending invariants remain tested; administrative review freshness is enforced by the registry/audit tests and normal gates.

C722.positive_profile: Independent numeric-literal-legacy-real-kinds checks mandatory method/minimum conditions before optional applicability, then qualifies REAL32=4, REAL64=8 and double kind equal to REAL64. source_only_case_rationales.R713_invalid__numeric_double_leading_sig: DATA requires the actual signed-real-literal form, not a general unary expression. R713 permits one sign and R714 cannot start with the second minus. Removing one minus repairs the same-kind zero value; generic DATA/parenthesis recovery is not credited.
source_only_case_rationales.R715_invalid__numeric_bare_dot: R715 requires a digit on at least one side of the decimal point. Adding zero makes the isolated DATA value valid; only the specific bare-dot route is retained.
source_only_case_rationales.R718_invalid__numeric_missing_comma: The two literal parts lack their required separator. Inserting one comma repairs the complete complex literal. The specific unexpected-second-real-token route is retained; bare delimiter recovery is not.
source_only_case_rationales.R718_invalid__numeric_third_part: R718 has exactly two parts, not three. Removing the third comma/part is the minimal repair; the specific extra-comma token route is not a general parenthesis-recovery allowance.
source_only_case_rationales.R719_invalid__numeric_constant_expressio: The first complex part is a forbidden general operator expression, not one of R719's alternatives. Removing the plus and second double-zero literal isolates the condition without an unsupported named-part mask.
source_only_case_rationales.R720_invalid__numeric_constant_expressio: The corresponding forbidden operator expression is in the second part governed by R720. The same literal-only one-construct repair preserves type/kind and all surrounding grammar.
source_only_case_rationales.R719_invalid__numeric_signed_name_part: R719 permits signed numeric literals or a named constant, not a sign applied to a name. Removing the sign repairs the already scalar real PARAMETER. The remaining full relationship message is prospective, not observed support.
source_only_case_rationales.R720_invalid__numeric_signed_name_part: The same unambiguous sign-before-name exclusion applies to R720's imaginary part. Its independent repair and position-specific prospective contract are retained.
source_only_case_rationales.C723_invalid__numeric_real_complex_type: The first named part is already a scalar COMPLEX PARAMETER, satisfying lookup/constancy/rank but not C723's integer-or-real restriction. The integer replacement repairs only type; GNU extension acceptance and Flang f2018 do not qualify.
source_only_case_rationales.C723_invalid__numeric_imaginary_complex_: The independently tested second named part has the same forbidden COMPLEX type with otherwise valid scalar/PARAMETER premises. No first-part result substitutes for this position.
source_only_case_rationales.R725_invalid__numeric_abbreviated_true: .T. is not the full source true literal in this DATA constant position, nor a valid operand-bearing defined operation. Replacing it with .TRUE. repairs only spelling.
source_only_case_rationales.R725_invalid__numeric_abbreviated_false: The corresponding .F. abbreviation is not .FALSE. in source. Its exact same-kind one-value replacement is valid without truth-bit assumptions.
source_only_case_rationales.R725_invalid__numeric_missing_dot: The source true literal requires its closing dot. Adding it repairs the sole lexical defect; generic DATA-value recovery is not credited.
source_only_case_rationales.C725_invalid__bare_suffix: The bare integer-literal char-length alternative excludes a kind suffix. The selector name is already a supported scalar integer constant; removing only its suffix leaves valid CHARACTER*3.
source_only_case_rationales.C726_invalid__allocate_mixed: The asterisk ALLOCATE type-spec requires every allocation object to carry the corresponding assumed parameter. A local deferred object does not; removing only that object repairs the all-assumed-dummy allocation.
source_only_case_rationales.C728_invalid__elemental: C728 explicitly excludes ELEMENTAL assumed-length functions. IMPURE removes the additional implicit PURE condition, and the fixed-length scalar repair satisfies the independently checked elemental premises.
source_only_case_rationales.C729_invalid__allocate_comma: The legacy optional length comma is outside its permitted type-declaration-stmt context in ALLOCATE. The object already has the required deferred ALLOCATABLE attribute; deleting only the comma repairs the type-spec.
source_only_case_rationales.C729_invalid__component_comma: A data-component-def-stmt is not the permitted type-declaration-stmt context. Removing the comma leaves a valid scalar constant-length component.
source_only_case_rationales.C729_invalid__function_comma: A FUNCTION prefix is not the permitted comma context. The repaired fixed-length function has a defined result; declaration/EOF recovery is not the cause.
source_only_case_rationales.C730_invalid__double_colon: C730 forbids the optional length comma when :: is present. The repair removes that comma while retaining the valid declaration, name and ::.
source_only_case_rationales.R721_invalid__kind_keyword_positional_le: The KIND-first alternative requires LEN= for a following length. Inserting LEN= repairs the grammar while retaining the supported selector and scalar constant length.
source_only_case_rationales.R721_invalid__len_keyword_positional_kin: The LEN-keyword-first alternative requires KIND= before its second selector. Inserting that keyword preserves the same valid scalar kind constant.
source_only_case_rationales.R723_invalid__bare_expression: The bare alternative is an integer literal, not an unparenthesized sum. Parentheses turn 2+1 into the permitted type-param-value form.
source_only_case_rationales.R724_invalid__prefix_separator: The optional character kind prefix requires an underscore before the delimiter. The already-defined supported scalar integer selector is otherwise valid; inserting only the underscore repairs the constant.
